system.description:
Required Weapon: Dual Daggers A Montaigne street-fighting style focused on speed and confusion. Duellists wield a long knife in each hand and overwhelm with relentless attacks.

  • Boucher’s Step. By pressing your enemy into a corner with a flash of small, persistent cuts, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Exhausted - while in this state, they have Disadvantage on all physical rolls.
  • Violent Thrusts. You add your Brawn to weapon damage.
  • Relentless Attacks. When an adversary makes a damage roll, you may mark a Stress to force them to deal minimum damage instead.
